title: Article fetch by number incurs extra overview query for Message-ID
description: EXTRA DB ROUND-TRIP ON ARTICLE HOT PATH — lookup_article_content_by_number (lifecycle.rs:1077) fetches wire bytes from IPFS, then scans headers with extract_header_value to extract the Message-ID as a String, then issues a separate overview_store.query_by_msgid() call to retrieve did_sig_valid. This is 2 DB queries + 1 IPFS fetch + a header scan per ARTICLE N command. The Message-ID is already stored in article_numbers alongside the CID; an overview lookup by (group, article_number) instead of by message-id would reduce this to 1 DB query with no header scan.
